nativeNoExit.wire: native-wire.bin is exactly 66002 bytes: expected 64-byte frozen configuration followed by six fixed frames (65938 bytes). Existing ZipFixture.Payload supplies 65537 bytes for stored-chunk payload.bin; sample expectations unchanged. Helper compares all 64 stdin config bytes before copying exact bounded wire and requires file EOF. Host rechecks exact wire afterwards.
nativeNoExit.ownership: Single native process, no fork/child/dup. Own stdout must be write-only FIFO. Read-only /proc/self/fd audit (at most 4096 entries) checks dev/inode with exactly one writer at STDOUT_FILENO before closing and zero after closing. Unknown refs/audit failure exit 71, never closed or accepted. Only own opened sidecar/directory descriptors and STDOUT_FILENO are closed. stdin/stderr stay open.
nativeNoExit.proof: 96-byte NXP1 v1 little-endian native-proof.bin: JobId[8:24], PID@24, parent PID@28, pipe dev@32/inode@40, writers-before=1@48/after=0@52, wireBytes=65938@56, phase=1@60, CLOCK_MONOTONIC close/alive ns@64/72, reserved zero[80:96]. Alive is at least 50ms after close; stdout EBADF verified. ready=1 is written only after proof. Helper then pauses until host termination or its independent 12-second alarm.
nativeNoExit.acceptance: Proof plus same PID/JobId, ordered terminal/EOF/exit-wait trace, no process.exit.end, BudgetExceeded, nonzero non-71 confirmed worker exit, unchanged identity/preservation/cleanup/supervisor gates. Missing, invalid or unexpected evidence is not pass. Full trace remains mandatory; ready/PID/self-report alone are insufficient.
nativeNoExit.retained: native-wire.bin, native-proof.bin and native-evidence.json remain only in owned central run directory; no generated data included in source PR.
nativeNoExit.limitations: Self-observation of a pinned trusted helper plus actual host EOF is not OS loader attestation. Helper has no duplicate/inherited writer creation path, but inaccessible procfs or unexpected refs block. Managed extra-fd owners remain unknown. Native compile/runtime and Linux pipe/deadline behavior require central validation; Windows remains separately unverified. Shared malformed error classification and all seven unavailable gates remain.
